queries.name: Activation steering
queries.query: "activation steering" OR "activation addition" OR "steering vector" OR "activation intervention"

queries.name: Representation engineering
queries.query: "representation engineering" OR "representation reading" OR "representation control" OR "control vector"

queries.name: Steering language models
queries.query: ("steer" OR "steering" OR "control") AND ("large language model" OR LLM OR "language model") AND (activation OR representation OR vector)

queries.name: Activation editing
queries.query: "activation patching" OR "activation editing" OR "latent steering" OR "feature steering" OR "sparse autoencoder"

queries.name: VLM and multimodal steering
queries.query: ("vision-language model" OR VLM OR multimodal OR "large multimodal model") AND (steering OR activation OR representation OR intervention)

queries.name: Diffusion language model steering
queries.query: ("diffusion language model" OR DLLM OR "diffusion LLM" OR "diffusion model") AND (steering OR activation OR representation OR control)

queries.name: Model families
queries.query: (transformer OR "foundation model" OR "large model") AND ("activation steering" OR "steering vector" OR "representation engineering" OR "activation intervention")
